findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential unsafe shell command usage in s3fs
 * @description Detect usages of os.system, subprocess, or similar in s3fs which might lead to command injection.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/s3fs/unsafe-shell-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of shell command execution API here may be unsafe if user input is incorporated."
findings.hypothesis: The package may invoke shell commands via os.system or subprocess, potentially allowing command injection if untrusted input is used (CWE-78).

message.text: Use of shell command execution API here may be unsafe if user input is incorporated.
